items.title: Jillean Williams interviewed by Milt Fillius and Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 20, 1995
items.q: And there was Grover Mitchell who used to be in the band.

ctx.x: I forget, the name, was it like, Cleveland [Eaton].
Cleveland. Not Grover Cleveland, that was a president. And there was Grover Mitchell who used to be in the band.
Yeah, there are some kind of young players now, they’ve got to carry it on.
